sections.Profile:
The "Dolly Parton" pinball machine, released by Bally in November 1979, features a design by George Christian and artwork by Dave Christensen. With a production run of 7,350 units, this machine is themed around the iconic country singer Dolly Parton. The game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, five stand-up targets, and an inline drop target bank. Players aim to spell "DOLLY" and "PARTON" for bonuses.
